name: MCP Knowledge Graph Memory
license: Apache-2.0 and MIT (servers repo LICENSE is dual during relicensing)
ontology_notes: Types in KnowledgeGraphManager are Entity {name, entityType, observations:string[]}, Relation {from, to, relationType}, and KnowledgeGraph. entityType is a free string (person, organization, event in the README). There is no user bio, character autobiography, relationship state, lore, or session working-memory type. Stars are for the parent modelcontextprotocol/servers repo, not this package alone. Package is @modelcontextprotocol/server-memory.

ontology.evidence: src/memory/index.ts exports Entity, Relation, KnowledgeGraph. Observations are untyped strings on an entity. README Core Concepts names those three records only.
ontology.label: measured

write_policy.evidence: Tools create_entities, create_relations, add_observations. The model decides what to store. create_entities ignores existing names. README System Prompt tells the host to extract identity, behaviors, preferences, goals, and relations. No write refusal.
write_policy.label: measured

read_policy.evidence: searchNodes in src/memory/index.ts is case-insensitive substring over name, entityType, and observations. Also read_graph, open_nodes, and MCP resource memory://knowledge-graph. Retrieval is a model tool call. Empty search returns no nodes.
read_policy.label: measured

supersession.evidence: add_observations appends contents not already in entity.observations. create_entities ignores duplicate names. There is no overwrite or invalidate. Replacement is delete then add.
supersession.label: measured

temporal.evidence: Entity and Relation have no timestamp fields in src/memory/index.ts. searchNodes has no date parse. JSONL lines are type/name/observations only.
temporal.label: measured

identity_split.evidence: One JSONL file (MEMORY_FILE_PATH). README System Prompt assumes a single default_user. No user vs character vs relationship namespaces.
identity_split.label: measured

silence.evidence: No tag, filter, or skip path in searchNodes. Matching substring always returns.
silence.label: measured

poisoning.evidence: No provenance, trust tag, or content filter. Stored observation text is returned verbatim on search.
poisoning.label: measured

forgetting.evidence: delete_entities, delete_observations, delete_relations. delete_entities also drops incident relations. Exact string match. No decay.
forgetting.label: measured

cost_shape.evidence: Server does no LLM or embedding calls. Cost is host tool calls plus the tokens of whatever graph the model reads. read_graph injects the whole file.
cost_shape.label: measured

local.evidence: JSONL on disk. npx @modelcontextprotocol/server-memory. No vendor API. README License section says MIT; repo LICENSE is Apache-2.0 plus remaining MIT.
local.label: measured

mcp.evidence: Official reference server listed at modelcontextprotocol.io/examples and published as @modelcontextprotocol/server-memory.
mcp.label: measured

companion_fit_reason: Substring graph of free-text observations with no identity split, no time, no silence, and no write filter. The host prompt is told to retrieve then act as if that is memory.
open_unknowns: Star count is for modelcontextprotocol/servers as a whole, not the memory package.
